senses.title: A fixed series of steps
senses.definition: an ordered set of actions that must be followed to complete a task
senses.definitionCN: 为完成某项任务而必须依次执行的一组动作
senses.example: The lab has a written procedure for handling every sample.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室对每一个样本的处理都有书面步骤。
senses.why: The word came from a verb meaning to go forward, so a procedure is a path laid out to be walked in order.
senses.whyCN: 这个词出自意为「向前走」的动词，因此程序就是一条铺好、须按顺序走完的路线。

senses.title: The official way of handling a matter
senses.definition: the recognized sequence by which an official body accepts, hears or decides something
senses.definitionCN: 官方机构受理、审议或决定某事所认可的次序
senses.example: The complaint went through the standard procedure for appeals.
senses.exampleCN: 这项投诉走了标准的上诉手续。
senses.why: Anything a body must do in a set order becomes a procedure, because the order is what makes the decision valid.
senses.whyCN: 机构必须按固定次序完成的事都叫程序，因为正是这个次序使决定有效。

senses.title: A medical treatment that acts on the body
senses.definition: a treatment in which a doctor performs a defined action on or inside the body
senses.definitionCN: 医生在体表或体内施行的一套明确操作
senses.example: The procedure took forty minutes and needed no overnight stay.
senses.exampleCN: 这台操作用了四十分钟，不需要留院过夜。
senses.why: Medicine borrowed the word for any defined course of action on a patient, and the sense narrowed to interventions.
senses.whyCN: 医学借这个词指对病人的一套明确处置，后来收窄为各种介入操作。

senses.title: The accepted order of business in a meeting
senses.definition: the rules that govern how a meeting or assembly conducts its business
senses.definitionCN: 会议或议会处理事务时遵循的规则
senses.example: The chair reminded the committee of its own procedure.
senses.exampleCN: 主席提醒委员会注意自己定的议事规程。
senses.why: A meeting is valid only if it moves through the agreed steps, so the rules of order took this name.
senses.whyCN: 会议只有按商定的步骤推进才有效，因此议事规则也用了这个名称。

senses.title: A named block of code in a program
senses.definition: a section of a program that performs one task and returns control to the point that called it
senses.definitionCN: 程序中完成单项任务并把控制权交回调用处的一段代码
senses.example: The program calls the same procedure every time it reads a record.
senses.exampleCN: 程序每读一条记录就调用同一个子程序。
senses.why: Computing reused the word for a routine because a routine is a small ordered path through the machine's work.
senses.whyCN: 计算机把这个词用于例行程序，因为一段例程就是机器工作中一条小型有序路径。

senses.title: The usual way a job is done in a place
senses.definition: the established way of doing a job in a particular workplace, whether or not it is written down
senses.definitionCN: 某一工作场所既定的做事方式，无论是否写成文字
senses.example: Checking the seals twice is procedure on this rig, not a personal habit.
senses.exampleCN: 在这座钻井平台上，密封件查两遍是规程，不是个人习惯。
senses.why: An unwritten habit becomes procedure once a crew treats it as the required order, so the word covers custom as well as rule.
senses.whyCN: 一旦班组把它当作必须遵循的次序，未成文的习惯也成了程序，因此这个词兼指惯例与规章。

senses.title: The steps by which a case moves through court
senses.definition: the rules that fix what a party must file, when and in what form during litigation
senses.definitionCN: 规定当事人在诉讼中须提交什么、何时提交、以何种形式提交的规则
senses.example: Civil procedure decides what a plaintiff must file and when.
senses.exampleCN: 民事诉讼程序决定原告必须提交什么、何时提交。
senses.why: Legal systems separate substance from steps, and the steps are called procedure because they carry a case forward in order.
senses.whyCN: 法律体系把实体与步骤分开，而这些步骤被称为程序，因为它们按次序把一个案子往前推进。

senses.title: One stage in an industrial process
senses.titleCN: 工序；工艺流程中的一环
senses.definition: a single defined operation within a manufacturing or chemical sequence
senses.definitionCN: 制造或化工流程中一道界限明确的加工步骤
senses.example: Each procedure in the line has its own temperature range.
senses.exampleCN: 流水线上每一道工序都有自己的温度区间。
senses.why: A factory breaks a long making into ordered steps, and each step inherits the name of the whole path.
senses.whyCN: 工厂把漫长的制造拆成有序步骤，每一道步骤都继承了整条路径的名称。

intro.en: Procedure came through French from Latin procedere 'to go forward', built on pro- 'forward' and cedere 'to go, to yield'. The pre-Latin root of cedere is a reconstruction. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词经法语来自拉丁语「向前走」的动词，由意为「向前」的前缀与意为「走、让」的动词构成。后者更早的词根属重构形式。年代均为约数。

items.en: Cedere meant 'to go, to withdraw, to yield'. Its deeper origin is not attested; the root usually proposed for it is a reconstruction, so source uncertain at that depth.
items.cn: cedere 意为「走、退、让」。其更深来源没有书证；通常为它提出的词根属重构形式，故更深一层来源不确定。

items.en: Pro- 'forward' plus cedere produced procedere 'to go forward, to advance, to continue'.
items.cn: pro-「向前」加 cedere 构成 procedere，意为「向前走、推进、继续」。

items.en: Late and Medieval Latin formed procedura for the manner of proceeding in a matter, especially in law.
items.cn: 晚期与中世纪拉丁语构成 procedura，指处理某事的进行方式，尤用于法律。

items.en: French procédure brought the noun into English in the fourteenth century, first as the conduct of a legal action.
items.cn: 法语 procédure 在十四世纪把这个名词带入英语，最初指法律诉讼的进行方式。

items.en: From the seventeenth century the word covered meeting rules, from the nineteenth medical interventions, and from the twentieth a block of code in computing.
items.cn: 自十七世纪起，这个词涵盖议事规则；十九世纪起涵盖医疗介入；二十世纪起涵盖计算机中的代码段。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same Latin verb of going, plus one word of Greek origin that looks similar; group two holds words for ways of doing things.
note.cn: 第一组是同出拉丁「走」动词的词，外加一个形似而来源不同的希腊词；第二组是表示做事方式的近义词。

entries.definition: A continuous course of change rather than an ordered checklist; the same Latin verb, a different noun suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 指连续变化的过程，而非有序清单；同一拉丁动词，名词后缀不同。

entries.definition: The carrying on of an action, or its record in court; it names the activity, not the rules for it.
entries.definitionCN: 指行动的进行，或其在法庭上的记录；它指活动本身，而不是活动的规则。

entries.definition: Pra- 'before' plus cedere: something that went before and now guides later decisions, not a set of steps.
entries.definitionCN: pra-「在前」加 cedere：先前发生、如今指导后续决定的事例，不是一套步骤。

entries.definition: From Greek protokollon, the first sheet glued to a roll; it became a diplomatic or technical code, not a Latin path.
entries.definitionCN: 出自希腊语「贴在卷首的第一张纸」，后来指外交或技术约定，与拉丁的「路径」无关。

entries.definition: A systematic way of doing something, often chosen by the doer rather than imposed by an authority.
entries.definitionCN: 系统性的做法，常由执行者自行选择，而非由权威规定。

entries.definition: A regular way of doing something because it is familiar and repeated, with no claim of formal validity.
entries.definitionCN: 因熟悉而重复的惯常做法，并不强调正式效力。

entries.definition: A single action in a sequence; a procedure is the whole sequence of such actions.
entries.definitionCN: 序列中的单个动作；程序则是这些动作的整个序列。

entries.definition: The organized set of parts and rules taken together, wider than one procedure.
entries.definitionCN: 由各部分与规则构成的整体安排，比单个程序更宽。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: 'Forward' plus 'to go': a procedure is a path laid out so that work can be walked through in order.
normal.cn: 「向前」加「走」：程序就是一条铺好的路径，让工作按顺序走完。

normal.en: The same verb yields the verb to continue, the noun for a court record and the word for a continuous process.
normal.cn: 同一动词还给出表示「继续」的动词、表示法庭记录的名词，以及表示连续过程的名词。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the settings: standard procedure, safety procedure, legal procedure, surgical procedure.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出场景：标准程序、安全规程、法律程序、外科手术。

normal.en: A hospital, a court and a committee each keep a written path that must be followed in order.
normal.cn: 医院、法院与委员会各自都有一份必须按顺序走完的书面路径。

normal.en: Computing calls a small ordered routine a procedure because it is a short path through the machine's work.
normal.cn: 计算机把一小段有序例程称为子程序，因为它是机器工作中一条短路径。

abstract.en: Picture a corridor with numbered doors, each of which must be opened before the next one.
abstract.cn: 想象一条走廊，每隔一段有一扇编号的门，必须依次打开。

abstract.en: Picture a dance notation that only works if every count is danced in place.
abstract.cn: 想象一份舞谱，只有每一拍都踩准才成立。

abstract.en: Picture a legal file that is valid only because every stamp sits in the right order.
abstract.cn: 想象一份法律卷宗，只因每枚印章次序正确才有效。

examples.en: Changing the procedure required the approval of the whole committee.
examples.cn: 更改程序需要全体委员会批准。

examples.en: The surgeon explained the procedure to the family in plain words.
examples.cn: 外科医生用平实的话向家属解释了这台手术。

examples.en: A missing signature sent the file back to the start of the procedure.
examples.cn: 少了一个签名，文件被退回程序的起点。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pro（向前）+ ced（走）+ ure（名词）」——一路向前走完的路线 → 程序、步骤、手续

root: 拉丁语「向前走」的动词由意为「向前」的前缀与意为「走、让」的动词构成，加名词后缀再构成「进行方式」；该动词更早的词根属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one path: a set of steps is laid down, then adopted by an office, applied to a body, imposed on a meeting, coded into a machine, hardened into local custom, stretched into litigation and finally shortened to one stage on a factory line.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条路径展开：先铺下一套步骤，再被机构采用、施于身体、用于会议、写进机器，固化为本地惯例，延伸为诉讼，最后缩短为工厂流水线上的一环。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a numbered card on the wall of a hospital corridor, each line ticked in order before anyone may proceed.
core.cn: 核心意象：医院走廊墙上一张编号卡片，每一行都按顺序打勾后才允许继续。

branches.en: LAID PATH AND LOCAL HABIT: a written sequence and an unwritten one are the same order once a crew treats it as required.
branches.cn: 铺好的路径与本地习惯：书面次序与未成文次序，一旦被班组视为必须，便是同一种次序。

branches.en: FORMAL VALIDITY: what an office accepts and what a court requires are both orders that make a result valid.
branches.cn: 正式效力：机构受理与法院要求，都是使结果有效的次序。

branches.en: ONE OPERATION: a treatment on a body and a stage on a line are single steps cut out of a longer path.
branches.cn: 单次操作：施于身体的一台操作与流水线上的一道工序，都是从更长路径中截出的单步。

branches.en: RULES OF ORDER: a meeting valid only if it moves through the agreed steps.
branches.cn: 议事规则：会议只有按商定步骤推进才有效。

branches.en: CODED PATH: computing writes the same ordered path into a block of instructions.
branches.cn: 编码路径：计算机把同一条有序路径写成一段指令。

intro.en: Procedure is a Latin noun of path and motion: a prefix meaning forward, a verb meaning to go, and a noun suffix marking the result.
intro.cn: 这是一个表示路径与运动的拉丁名词：一个意为「向前」的前缀、一个意为「走」的动词，以及标记结果的名词后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin cedere gives proceed, process, precede and succeed; pro- adds forward motion; the noun suffix marks a way of doing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语「走」动词衍生出继续、过程、先于与接着等词；「向前」前缀加进向前的运动；名词后缀标记一种做法。

items.structure: cedere, cessi, cessum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
items.example: The root carries movement along a line.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根承载沿一条线移动的意思。

items.example: The prefix fixes the direction of the movement.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀确定运动的方向。

items.example: The verb is the whole path in one word.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词用一个词表达了整条路径。

items.example: The noun turned the path into a thing that can be written down.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词把路径变成可以写下来的东西。

items.example: The English noun still means a path to be walked.
items.exampleCN: 这个英语名词仍指一条要走完的路径。

items.meaning: result or instrument of an action
items.example: The suffix marks the outcome of the verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀标记动词的结果。

items.meaning: relating to steps or formal rules
items.meaningCN: 与步骤或正式规则有关的
items.example: A procedural objection concerns how a decision was made.
items.exampleCN: 程序性异议针对决定是怎么样作出的。

items.example: The train proceeded once the signal changed.
items.exampleCN: 信号一变，列车继续前行。

items.example: The same verb, seen as a flowing course rather than a checklist.
items.exampleCN: 同一个动词，被看作流动的过程而非清单。

latinEntries.meaning: to go, to withdraw, to yield
